whatChanged:
COMPLIANCE REVIEW REQUIRED — consent capture, and the words a client reads before they agree.

A closer can now see BOTH reasons a credit pull would be refused, and hand the client a link to fix either one. Nobody on staff ever types a Social Security number.

Three parts.

1) The consent endpoint (api/consent/capture.mjs). Its existing GET now also returns a freshly signed client link with the time it stops working, plus a plain yes/no on whether we already hold an identity for that person. No new route. Only for the soft-pull kind — a dispute-authorization request gets neither, and never reads the identity table at all. A staff session gets the link; a signed-in client does not (they can already reach the page, and the link is a password in disguise). If the system has no signing key, the link comes back empty with a sentence saying why instead of the whole screen breaking.

2) The staff screen (client-control-panel.html). Inside the existing Actions block — no new page, tab, menu row or sidebar entry. Two sentences instead of one: whether the client agreed, and whether we hold their details. When either is missing, a box appears with the link, a Copy button, and the time it expires. If consent was withdrawn, nothing is offered at all — the same rule the screen already followed for the "record consent" shortcut. The pull buttons are NOT switched off for a missing identity, on purpose: on the bureau's test system no identity is needed, so switching them off would block a pull that works.

3) The client page (soft-pull-approve.html). Three fixes, no redesign. It was showing "soft-pull-v1" as a heading to a consumer — now it says "Soft pull authorization" and the version moves under the paragraph. A "What happens next" list now appears before they type, not only in tiny print under the button. And the address is trimmed before sending, so a box holding only a space can no longer be treated as filled in.

On the address-erasure worry: it is not reachable. The server refuses the whole submission if any address box is empty (api/soft-pull-approve.mjs:178-188), so the record-wiping write never happens. The trim just stops a pointless round trip and keeps the form permanently unable to send a blank address. Both facts are now written into the file so nobody removes the guard later.

notes: THE ONE SETTING THIS NEEDS: DOCUMENT_URL_SECRET. Name only, never the value. It is the same setting the emailed version of this link already uses (src/sales/closer-deck.mjs:354-363), so if the Present deck can send a soft-pull email today, this is already set and nothing needs doing. If it is ever missing, the screen says so in words instead of going blank. The link's web address comes from PUBLIC_BASE_URL.

WHAT ONLY A PERSON CAN CHECK, ON A REAL DEPLOY: open a real client's control panel for someone who has agreed but has no details on file. Confirm the second red line appears, press Copy link, paste it into a private browser window, and confirm the client form opens and saves. I was told not to touch the live site, so this is the one step I could not do.

WORDING IS THE OTHER THING ONLY YOU CAN JUDGE. Read the two new red sentences on the closer's screen and the three-step 'What happens next' list on the client page. They make no claim about what a credit report will say or what funding will follow.

LEFT UNDONE, DELIBERATELY: nothing was skipped or worked around. No live check and no deploy preview (instructed not to). No journey file update needed — journeys are generated from the routing table and the gate on each handler, and I added no route and changed no gate; `npm run journeys:check` says 'docs/journeys is up to date (9 files)'. So no changelog line either. I edited only the four files I was given, plus three screenshots dropped in the batch's existing T3 evidence folder.

BOARD ITEM — the base-web-address code is now copied three times and the copies disagree. There are two families in this repo that read different settings: PUBLIC_BASE_URL (src/sales/closer-deck.mjs:331, api/contracts.mjs:86, api/read/portal-contracts.mjs:18) and APP_BASE_URL (src/messaging/dispatch.mjs:56, src/workflows/messaging.mjs:56, api/social/oauth.mjs:17). None is exported, so none can be shared. I copied the closer-deck one exactly, because it mints this same link for the email version and the copied link must land in the same place as the emailed one. Proven identical with diff. Fixing the duplication is somebody's separate job.

BOARD ITEM — src/consent/disclosures.mjs already holds a human title ('Soft Pull Authorization') for each consent version, but api/soft-pull-approve.mjs:132-136 sends version, text and bullets and not title. That is why the client page was printing 'soft-pull-v1' as a heading. I wrote a plain label into the page instead, since that file is not mine. Also: 'bullets' is always empty — no disclosure entry has that field.

BOARD ITEM — the $32 price is typed by hand twice in public/app/soft-pull-approve.html (about lines 71 and 89) instead of coming from the offer catalog. I did NOT add a third copy; my new step just says 'the payment link' with no number.

BOARD ITEM — storeIdentity (src/pii/index.mjs:138) replaces the whole address list rather than merging it. Not a bug for this form, which always sends exactly one address and is refused if any part is blank. But a client who had three addresses on file ends up with one after they fill this in. Worth a decision, not a fix from this thread.

BOARD ITEM, AND IT AFFECTS HOW YOU READ ANY GREEN RESULT — `npm test` stops after the unit tests if any of them fail (scripts/run-suite.mjs:68-69). Main is red right now, so the database tests NEVER RUN under `npm test` on this branch. Anyone quoting an `npm test` result today is quoting unit tests only. I ran the relevant database tests by hand against the scratch database instead.

SMALL THING I DID NOT TOUCH: the three bureau buttons already get switched off when consent is missing, but they do not LOOK switched off — .action-btn has no disabled styling. That is how it was before me. The reason still shows as a sentence above them and as a tooltip on them.
